# Experimental Plugin Record Catalog

These current-source PluginRecordMap declarations describe ignorable, log-only records owned by experimental packages. Payload annotations link to their owning source without expanding referenced types. Records stay outside the known-event set, persistence schema fingerprints, and compatibility history; format migrations retain them on a best-effort basis.

Run `pnpm run gen-persistence-catalog` to regenerate both persistence catalogs, their language pairs, and associated artifacts. `pnpm run verify-persistence-catalog` checks all generated files.

Shared Session event declarations and resolved schemas appear in the [Session persistence event catalog](./persistence-catalog.md).

| Record | Owner | Purpose | Payload and source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugin:action-cards/decision` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-action-cards` | Dismissals and kind-defined progress of action cards. | <code>ActionCardDecision</code> · [`packages/experimental/action-cards/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/action-cards/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:client-ui-forge/worktree` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-forge` | A request, withdrawal, or creation of the worktree a Session starts in. | <code>WorktreeRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/client-ui-forge/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/client-ui-forge/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:forge-session/binding` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-forge-session` | A caller or discovery action that binds, restores, or hides one change request. | <code>BindingRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/forge-session/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/forge-session/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:translator/request` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` | Provider-independent translation input, retained before dispatch. | <code>TranslationRequestRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/translator/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/translator/src/types.ts) |
| `plugin:translator/result` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` | Successful translation, retained before it is returned to the consumer. | <code>TranslationResultRecord</code> · [`packages/experimental/translator/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/experimental/translator/src/types.ts) |
